The HWPX document automation pipeline achieved full success by maintaining a stable verifier reward of 1.00 across the final iteration.
The execution concluded with a 100% pass rate in the pytest suite (test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite) and a verifier_reward of 1.00. While the judge_reward of 0.82 suggests minor room for optimization in output quality, the core logic remained robust through iteration 7. Reusable success was driven by the stable integration of the llmrouter, though future runs should monitor the 3m 42s runtime for potential latency bottlenecks.
